newsitem.title: GERMANY: Henkel says to buy 280 mln dm unit from Novamax.
newsitem.headline: Henkel says to buy 280 mln dm unit from Novamax.

text.p: German chemicals and consumer products group Henkel KGaA said on Thursday it planned to take over a metallochemistry unit from U.S.-based Novamax of the Molson Group for 280 million marks ($182.7 million).
"The acquisition from Novamax will strengthen Henkel's worldwide metallochemistry business in the United States, Europe, Asia and south America," Henkel said in a statement.
The transaction, to buy the metallochemistry unit of Novamax Technologies Corporation, will need the approval of the cartel authorities before completion, Henkel said.
Novamax, based in Atlanta, United States, was set up in 1988 as a division of Canada's Molson Group, it said.
Henkel said it was aiming to make more one billion marks in turnover from its metallochemistry business in 1996. ($ = 1.532 German Marks)
